description: Runbook for a concierge MVP: the founder delivers the outcome by hand to one real customer at a price set in advance, producing a concierge log and a willingness-to-pay score on the evidence ladder. Use when the user says do it by hand first, concierge test, deliver it manually, or wants to test if a customer will pay before automating. Not for an agent running the task to price it (use agent-concierge-probe).
